verdict.rationale: Pomelo documents its own transaction-processing surfaces. Digital accounts expose their activity (pomelo-docs-17), and transactions are authorized and then adjusted, with Reversals and Refunds delivered through an Adjustments endpoint (pomelo-docs-18, pomelo-docs-28). The Dashboard monitors card and transaction operations (pomelo-docs-14, pomelo-docs-27). These cover the transaction-ledger core only thinly. missing for 10: explicit real-time account/card balance evidence, documented linkage of each authorization to its clearing record, settlement/reconciliation reporting, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
